description: This file defines the CompareCondition class, which implements a conditional comparison operation within the OFBiz MiniLang framework. It handles parsing of the <if-compare> XML element, performs comparison logic, and manages sub-operations for true/false conditions.

classes.name: CompareCondition
classes.description: Represents a conditional comparison operation based on the <if-compare> XML element, supporting various comparison operators, types, and sub-operations.

classes.name: CompareCondition.CompareConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CompareCondition from XML elements.

methods.name: CompareCondition
methods.description: Constructor that parses the <if-compare> element, initializes comparison parameters, and sub-operations.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison condition based on the current method context.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes sub-operations based on the result of the condition check.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Generates a human-readable representation of the comparison condition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <if-compare> element with its attributes.
